impact.title: Audience of a verified change
impact.question: Classify the audience affected by the supplied verified behavior change. Explicit compatibility breaks take precedence. Do not infer a breaking change, release version, or unseen behavior from filenames alone.

criteria.compatibility: Explicitly removes or incompatibly changes a supported interface or behavior.
criteria.user: Changes behavior directly experienced by a product user without an explicit compatibility break.
criteria.operator: Changes deployment, configuration, installation, or operational behavior.
criteria.developer: Changes development, testing, or contribution workflows.
criteria.internal: Changes internal implementation with no stated external behavior change.
criteria.unsure: The evidence is ambiguous, mixed, or does not support a reliable choice.
